activity.notes: David Suzuki is a Canadian geneticist, broadcaster and environmental activist, not a head of state or government. ATLAS uses his 1979–2023 tenure hosting CBC's The Nature of Things as a bounded representative period of nationally significant public activity. The mod's 'Columbia' is an alternate/fictitious gameplay civilization and is not registered as a historical polity.

sources.title: David Suzuki Foundation — David Suzuki
sources.citation_text: The David Suzuki Foundation identifies Suzuki as a geneticist, broadcaster, environmental leader, UBC faculty member and host of CBC's The Nature of Things from 1979.

sources.title: David Suzuki Foundation — How David Suzuki widened the tent for us
sources.citation_text: The Foundation states in April 2023 that Suzuki had hosted The Nature of Things for 44 years until his final episode that month.
